name: Count Meowcula's Barbershop
detailed_description:
Welcome to the bloodiest barbershop in town.

Play as a vampire cat trying to run a barbershop… without biting the costumers.

Wash, cut, shave chat and fight your thirst. One haircut at a time.

Core Features

  • Chaotic minigames

Cut hair and trim beards with precision and quick reflexes. As your bloodlust increases, your controls get reversed.

Wash hair while dealing with a few tricky inverted arrows.

Each task gets harder the thirstier you become. And you thought that pretty doesn’t hurts.

  • Manage your reputation (and your bloodlust)

Bad cuts or bloody accidents will hurt your reputation.

Your performance influences the story, unlocking different endings. Some hilarious, others unsettling.

  • Clean up the evidence

Messed up? Clean up the mess quickly or risk raising suspicion.

Ignore a single stain and it might cost your credibilitu (or your costumer).

Characteristics

  • Unique bloodlust mechanic that affects the game’s difficulty

  • Multiple endings based on your performance

  • Minigames that get harder each day

  • An eccentric and atmospheric soundtrack

  • Characters full of dark humor

short_description: You're Count Meowcula, a vampire cat that opened a barbershop. Wash and cut hairs, also clean your establishment and try not to bite your clients in this creepy cute game with minigames and chaotic controls. Manage your instincts and your reputation. Who said that beauty does not require sacrifices?
